name: PWA NON-FIXED CRISP HEADER
changes: Moves the mobile root admin header out of position:fixed while preserving its visible geometry

notes: Targeted mobile rendering fix based on v16.4.14.
No Supabase, Edge Function, Monobank, Nova Poshta or VAcleaner runtime change.
The root header is no longer fixed on mobile; the main content remains the only scrolling root workspace region.
